fields.description: Hillcrest is a low-rise residential and retail development in Arjan. Its curved building edge encloses landscaped leisure spaces, while studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments offer different balcony arrangements. The published mix is weighted toward smaller homes, with only four two-bedroom apartments in the original project facts.

overview: A low-rise setting does not guarantee identical outlook or privacy across apartments. Compare the selected balcony, corridor position and enclosed plan before relying on a headline size.
research.locationNote: Arjan, Dubai, with access to Umm Suqeim Road and the wider road network. Plot-specific access and outlook remain subject to the chosen home.
research.priceNote: The retrieved own project hero displays FROM AED 799999. Its indexed UK unit cards instead show a studio from 820,999; Property Finder’s opened page shows about 821,000 in the header but retains 808,999 in narrative. These are separate changing references, not one confirmed current unit price.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder shows 20% at launch, 50% during construction and 30% on handover. A separate original developer payment document was not retrieved. Confirm any promotional deposit, instalment dates and fees against the selected apartment’s signed schedule. GCC Offplan separately lists 50% booking, 20% during construction and 30% at handover; that different offer is not substituted for the portal table.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists December 2026/Q4 2026. The own page retrieved does not provide a completion date. This portal target is not evidence of completed construction, approvals or keys; no current progress percentage is assumed.

facts.label: Building schedule
facts.value: Official facts state basement, ground, 4 residential floors and roof. The own FAQ calls it six-storey; portal narrative uses five-storey. Retain the component schedule rather than treating the shorthand counts as identical.

unresolved: Live availability, unit-level completion, service charges, parking entitlement, furnishing and a dated commercial offer were not established. Confirm them in writing.

The retrieved brochure’s visible total-area examples differ from some indexed inventory sizes. They are selected plan types including outdoor space; do not substitute one type for another. The agreement determines the actual unit area.
